confirmations.text:
Terms:

- **Confirmable section**: a section of `stapel.toml` whose owner is not `generated`.
- **Waiting section**: a confirmable section of the ticket without a fresh confirmation: never confirmed, or
  its latest confirmation is stale (`stapel_core::stage::freshness` gives a reason).
- **Key form**: `stapel ok KEY`. **Section form**: `stapel ok [KEY] <section>`.
- **Change block** of a section: what the person sees about it before its `confirmed:` line (AC-2).

| № | Criterion | Test |
|---|---|---|
| AC-1 | WHEN the key form runs in a terminal and the ticket has waiting sections THE `stapel ok` command prints `to confirm: <KEY> <ids joined by comma and space, stapel.toml order>`, then the change block of each, then one `confirmed:` line each (today's format); it appends one confirmation per waiting section (by, at, hash, normal form, depends_on, text, via `terminal`) in one write of `state.json`, then appends one `decisions.jsonl` record per section in today's format; fresh sections get neither (spec change, D1-5). A blank `user.name` refuses with exit 1 and no write, whether or not a section waits. Output: `golden/ok_key_form.txt`. | `ok_all::key_form_confirms_every_waiting_section`, `ok_all::key_form_blank_user_name_refused` |
| AC-2 | WHEN a change block is printed THE `stapel ok` command prints `== <id>: changed since the last confirmation` (followed by `; <other stale reasons>` when there are any) and a unified diff from the stored text when the section's hash changed; `== <id>: new, N lines` (`1 line` for one) when it was never confirmed or its latest confirmation has no stored text, followed by `; <stale reasons>` other than the text change when it was confirmed before (spec change, E-1); `== <id>: unchanged; <stale reasons>` when only a dependency or the normal form made it stale, and `== <id>: unchanged` for a fresh section confirmed again by the section form (spec change, D1-6). Several reasons are joined by `, `. Output: `golden/ok_change_blocks.txt`. | `ok_all::change_block_for_each_kind`, `ok_all::change_block_with_two_reasons`, `ok_all::new_with_reasons_in_terminal_and_dialog`, `ok_all::new_never_shows_the_text_change` |
| AC-3 | IF a waiting section, or a dependency of one, is missing or duplicated in `ticket.md` THEN the key form exits 1 with the one-section form's reason for that section, and `state.json` and `decisions.jsonl` stay byte for byte. | `ok_all::key_form_refuses_all_when_one_fails` |
| AC-4 | WHEN the key form runs and no section waits THE `stapel ok` command prints `nothing to confirm: <KEY>` (the folder key), exits 0 and changes no file. | `ok_all::key_form_with_nothing_waiting` |
| AC-5 | WHEN `stapel ok` gets one argument THE command takes it as a section when it is a section id of `stapel.toml` (any case, as today), else as a key when a ticket folder matches (any case), else exits 1 with `"X" is neither a section nor a ticket; sections: <ids>; open tickets: <keys>` (`none` when no ticket is open; spec change, D1-2). A closed or legacy ticket gives today's refusal of `prepare`. | `ok_all::one_argument_is_section_then_key`, `ok_all::section_id_wins_over_a_ticket_folder`, `ok_all::refusal_lists_only_open_tickets` |
| AC-6 | WHEN the section form confirms a section THE `stapel ok` command prints its change block before the `confirmed:` line; a fresh section is confirmed again, as today. | `ok_all::section_form_prints_change_block` |
| AC-7 | WHEN an agent runs the key form in a dialog permission mode THE guard answers `ask`: the reason names the ticket and, per waiting section, its id, short hash and `+a -b lines since last confirmation` (followed by `; <stale reasons>` whenever the section has stale reasons other than its own text change; spec change, D2-2) or `new, N lines` (`1 line` for one; with the same `; <stale reasons>` when the section was confirmed before, spec change, E-1); the replaced command is `<program> ok <folder key> --grant <token>`; one grant file is written. | `ok_all::dialog_lists_every_waiting_section`, `ok_all::dialog_shows_every_stale_reason`, `ok_all::new_with_reasons_in_terminal_and_dialog`, `ok_all::dialog_counts_added_and_removed_apart`, `ok_all::new_never_shows_the_text_change` |
| AC-8 | IF after the key-form dialog a waiting section's hash, one of its dependencies, or the set of waiting sections changes, or the grant expired (spec change, D2-4), THEN `stapel ok KEY --grant <token>` exits 1 with today's "the grant does not match" (or "the grant expired") reason and records nothing. A grant of the section form does not confirm the key form, nor the reverse. | `ok_all::key_form_grant_names_every_section`, `ok_all::key_form_grant_binds_a_generated_dependency`, `ok_all::section_form_grant_differs_by_action_only` |
| AC-9 | IF the key form runs in an agent's shell without a grant THEN it exits 1 with today's "only a person confirms" reason, naming `stapel ok KEY`; an argument that is neither a section nor a ticket gets the same refusal, not AC-5's list. | `ok_all::key_form_agent_shell_refused`, `ok_all::unresolved_argument_in_agent_shell_refused` |
| AC-10 | WHEN `stapel ok KEY --grant <token>` runs with the token of the key-form dialog and nothing changed THE command confirms every section the dialog listed, as AC-1, with `via` `grant`, and removes the grant; the same token then exits 1 with "the grant does not match". | `ok_all::key_form_grant_confirms_once` |
| AC-11 | IF an agent runs the key form in a dialog permission mode and no section waits THEN the guard denies with `nothing to confirm: <KEY>` and writes no grant file. | `ok_all::guard_denies_when_nothing_waits` |

### Guarantees

- **Promised:** the Frame's promise, by AC-1 to AC-11; the existing tests of `ok.rs` and `hook.rs` keep the
  section form's behaviour.
- **Not promised:** the Frame's list.

### Facts (external contract and states)

- F-1: `stapel_core::confirm::prepare` resolves the ticket and one section, refuses closed, legacy and
  unreadable tickets, and computes the hash, normal-form text and `depends_on`. Both `ok` and the guard's
  dialog call it, so the dialog refuses what the command would refuse.
- F-2: only the latest confirmation of a section keeps `text` (`ok.rs` clears older ones); confirmations
  written before STP-2 AC-10 have none, which AC-2 shows as `new, N lines`.
- F-3: `stage::freshness` gives the stale reasons; `stage::diff` gives the unified diff from the stored text;
  `Reason::describe` of `Changed` includes the confirmation time, so AC-2 prints its own heading for it to keep
  golden files stable.
- F-4: `config.section` and `tickets::resolve` match ids and keys in any case.
- F-5: a grant file name is a hash of the token and `Facts` (key, action, detail, hash, dependencies, crate
  version); `consume` removes the file whatever the outcome.
- F-6: the guard reads `stapel ok` arguments as words of the parsed command (`only_positional`); words built at
  run time are denied before `dialog::ask`.

### Decisions (before the build)

- The key form uses grant `Facts` with action `ok-key`, detail the waiting ids joined by `,`, hash the hashes
  joined by `,` in the same order, dependencies `id:dep=hash` of every waiting section. The section form keeps
  action `ok`. So neither grant opens the other form (AC-8).
- One function in `stapel-core` (`confirm::prepare_waiting`) returns the waiting sections, each as a
  `Prepared`, or the first refusal; the CLI and the guard share it.
- One function in `stapel-core` (`confirm::target`) applies AC-5's one-argument rule and returns a section
  target or a key target, or AC-5's refusal; `ok.rs` uses it in step 1 and `dialog::prepare_ask` in step 2, so
  the rule has one copy (SR1-5). A key target is returned whenever any ticket folder matches ignoring case, so
  `tickets::resolve` gives its own refusal for several matching folders (SR2-1).
- The change block is built in `stapel-core` (no printing there) and printed by the CLI.

### Decisions (as built)

#### Step 1

- `confirm::target(root, config, arg)` returns `Target::Section(arg)` when `config.section` matches, generated
  sections included (so `prepare` refuses them as today); `Target::Key(arg)` when any ticket folder matches
  ignoring case; else AC-5's refusal with the confirmable ids and the open keys, or `none`.
- `confirm::prepare_waiting(root, config, key)` returns one `Prepared` per waiting section in `stapel.toml`
  order by calling `prepare` for each, so a refusal is `prepare`'s reason. A missing dependency is itself a
  waiting section, so the refusal names the dependency (D1-8).
- `confirm::change_block(config, &Prepared)` is called before the new confirmation is added; it reads
  `ticket.md` again for the other stale reasons and treats a read error as no reasons (D1-7, note).
- `ok::run_one` resolves the argument with `target`; in an agent shell without a grant an unresolved argument
  gives the section-form refusal, keeping today's order of checks. `refuse_agent_shell(form)` names the form
  typed: `stapel ok KEY` for the key form.
- The key form computes the identity once (the spaced `user.name` warning is printed once) before
  `prepare_waiting`, as the section form does, so a missing `user.name` refuses even when nothing waits
  (D1-4, note). It writes `state.json` once, clears older stored text per section, prints the `confirmed:`
  lines, then appends the `decisions.jsonl` records.
- Until step 2 the key form refuses a grant with "a grant for `stapel ok KEY` is not supported yet" (D1-3).

#### Step 1c

- Coverage only, no code: three tests added to `ok_all.rs`; all passed against step 1's code.

#### Step 2

- `dialog::prepare_ask` calls `confirm::target` for one argument; a key target goes through `prepare_waiting`;
  a section target and the two-argument form behave as before. A shared `finish()` checks allow rules and
  issues the grant.
- With no waiting section the guard denies with `nothing to confirm: <folder>` before the allow-rule check and
  writes no grant.
- The reason: `stapel: confirm N waiting section(s) of KEY: <line> | <line>; runs: <program>. Answer Yes or
  No; …`, as the section form names only the program (DR-1). Each line is `id (sha256:<12 hex>…): +a -b lines since last confirmation`, or `new, N line(s)`
  (also when the latest confirmation has no stored text); when both counts are 0 the line gets `; <reasons>`
  joined by `, `, with `Changed` written without the time.
- `dialog::ok_key_facts(key, waiting)` builds the grant facts (action `ok-key`; detail the ids joined by `,`;
  hash the hashes joined by `,`; dependencies `section:dep=hash` of every waiting section).
- `ok::run_key` computes the waiting set, then the folder key (from the set, or `resolve` when it is empty), then consumes the grant with those facts, so a
  grant with an empty set gives "the grant does not match"; `via` is `grant` or `terminal`.
- The agent-shell refusal of the key form names the literal `stapel ok KEY`, as AC-9 says.
- `key_form_agent_shell_refused` passed before step 2's code (step 1 refuses already), so it is a coverage
  commit after the GREEN. The RED adds a file-level helper `ok_key_grant` used by two tests.

#### Step 3

- `dialog::waiting_line` appends `; <reasons>` for every stale reason but `Reason::Changed`, joined by `, `,
  through `Reason::describe` (no time in these reasons). A section with only `Changed` shows the counts alone;
  its counts are never both 0, because the hash is of the normal form and the stored text is that form.
- The coverage test rewrites `.stapel/stapel.toml` so that `plan` depends on `spec`, `design` and the generated
  `review`; the grant binds the hash of `## Review` although `review` never waits.

#### Step 4

- `confirm::change_block` computes the other stale reasons (all but `Reason::Changed`) before the stored-text
  check; a confirmed section without stored text prints `new, N line(s); <reasons>` when there are any, through
  the helper `confirm::new_line`. A never-confirmed section stays `new, N line(s)`.
- `dialog::waiting_line` follows the same order; the `+a -b` counts are computed only when stored text exists.
- Doc comments: `grant::Facts` names the actions `ok`, `ok-key` and `close` and the dependency forms `id=hash`
  and `section:dep=hash`; the `confirm.rs` module comment covers one section or every waiting section.
- `section_form_grant_differs_by_action_only` removes spec's confirmation from `state.json` after all four
  are confirmed, so only `spec` waits and no dependency changed.
- `stapel check` lists step 4's RED as one test: `change_block_for_each_kind` changed only through its golden
  file, which the check reports as "superseded by step 4" for steps 1 to 3.

| Criterion | Test |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | `ok_all::key_form_confirms_every_waiting_section`, `ok_all::key_form_blank_user_name_refused` |
| AC-2 | `ok_all::change_block_for_each_kind`, `ok_all::change_block_with_two_reasons`, `ok_all::new_with_reasons_in_terminal_and_dialog`, `ok_all::new_never_shows_the_text_change` |
| AC-3 | `ok_all::key_form_refuses_all_when_one_fails` |
| AC-4 | `ok_all::key_form_with_nothing_waiting` |
| AC-5 | `ok_all::one_argument_is_section_then_key`, `ok_all::section_id_wins_over_a_ticket_folder`, `ok_all::refusal_lists_only_open_tickets` |
| AC-6 | `ok_all::section_form_prints_change_block` |
| AC-7 | `ok_all::dialog_lists_every_waiting_section`, `ok_all::dialog_shows_every_stale_reason`, `ok_all::new_with_reasons_in_terminal_and_dialog`, `ok_all::dialog_counts_added_and_removed_apart`, `ok_all::new_never_shows_the_text_change` |
| AC-8 | `ok_all::key_form_grant_names_every_section`, `ok_all::key_form_grant_binds_a_generated_dependency`, `ok_all::section_form_grant_differs_by_action_only` |
| AC-9 | `ok_all::key_form_agent_shell_refused`, `ok_all::unresolved_argument_in_agent_shell_refused` |
| AC-10 | `ok_all::key_form_grant_confirms_once` |
| AC-11 | `ok_all::guard_denies_when_nothing_waits` |

Route: full (source: `auto`; tags `interface`, `guard`).

| Step | What | Criteria | Must not change |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `confirm::target`, `confirm::prepare_waiting` and the change block in `stapel-core`; the key form and the change block in `ok.rs` and `main.rs`, calling `confirm::target` | AC-1 to AC-6 | `grant.rs`, `dialog.rs`, the section form's records, existing tests |
| 1c | Coverage after the drift review of step 1: D1-1, D1-2, D1-7 (tests only, no code) | AC-2, AC-5 | `crates/*/src`, the six tests of step 1 |
| 2 | The key form in the guard's dialog and its grant facts; the agent-shell message | AC-7 to AC-11 | the section form's dialog reason and grant facts, `grant.rs` file naming |
| 3 | Every stale reason in the dialog (D2-2), RED and GREEN; then a coverage test for a generated dependency in the grant (D2-1) | AC-7, AC-8 | the terminal output, grant facts, the tests of steps 1 to 2 |
| 4 | Code review round 1: E-1 RED and GREEN (stale reasons after `new`), doc comments of `grant.rs` and `confirm.rs` (E-6) in the GREEN; then coverage for DR-2, R-2, E-2, E-3 | AC-1, AC-2, AC-7, AC-8, AC-9 | grant facts, the section form's dialog, test functions of steps 1 to 3 except `change_block_for_each_kind` through its golden file |
| 4b | Coverage after the drift review of step 4: D4-1 (tests only, no code) | AC-2, AC-7 | `crates/*/src`, test functions of steps 1 to 4 |
